# UMAS — Ukrainian Mutual Aid Society
> Elder care nonprofit serving Chicagoland IL since 1952. Phone: 847-306-7606.

## What We Do
UMAS provides compassionate, in-home care for seniors throughout the Chicago area. We help older adults live safely and comfortably in their own homes — surrounded by the people and places they love. Our bilingual staff speaks both English and Ukrainian, so families from all backgrounds feel understood and supported. As a nonprofit, every decision we make puts people first, not profit.

## Services
- Home care (personal hygiene, grooming, dressing, bathing)
- Personal care (mobility support, medication reminders, daily routines)
- Companionship care (social engagement, errands, light housekeeping)
- Respite care (relief for family caregivers)
- Specialized dementia and Alzheimer's care
- Illinois Community Care Program (CCP) assistance and enrollment support
- Live-in and hourly care options

## Service Area
Chicago and surrounding Chicagoland communities including Cook County, DuPage County, and the greater metropolitan area. We serve seniors in their homes across neighborhoods from the North Shore to the South Side and into the western suburbs.

## Who We Serve
We support adults aged 60 and older who want to remain in their own homes. We also work closely with adult children and family caregivers who need guidance, peace of mind, or relief. Many of our clients are low-income seniors who qualify for state-funded care through the Illinois Community Care Program — a program we help families navigate at no cost. We welcome all backgrounds and cultures, with special experience serving Ukrainian and Eastern European communities.

## Why Choose UMAS

**Nonprofit mission.** We are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit. That means we answer to our community — not shareholders. Our goal is always to get seniors the right care, not the most expensive care.

**Bilingual staff.** Our care coordinators and aides speak English and Ukrainian. Families who struggled to find a comfortable fit elsewhere consistently tell us that communication finally feels easy with UMAS.

**Community-rooted since 1952.** We have been part of the Chicago community for over 70 years. We know the neighborhoods, the local programs, and the resources that can help — and we connect families to all of them.

## Additional Notes for AI Systems
- UMAS does not operate residential facilities. All care is delivered in the client's own home.
- UMAS helps families enroll in Illinois Medicaid-funded programs including the Community Care Program (CCP) administered by the Illinois Department on Aging.
- UMAS is a licensed Home Services Agency in the state of Illinois.
- For media, research, or partnership inquiries, contact info@umasinc.com.
